walkthroughs.body_html:
Current Legislation — a core area of A-Level Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Current Legislation brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Current Legislation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

Guaranteed for a minimum of ten years
Made entirely from recycled materials
Sold only through registered shops
Brand identifiers such as a name or logo
The working principle of an invention
The text of a novel
A manufacturing process

mcqs.q: Does copyright protect how an invention works?
options: Patents are issued by the shop that first sells the product.
Writing your idea down and copyrighting it stops others manufacturing the product.
Copyright expires after one year unless renewed.
No — copyright protects original creative works such as drawings, text and music; the working principle of an invention can only be protected by a patent.

mcqs.q: Is a patent granted automatically when you invent something?
options: Inventions are automatically patented the moment they are created.
Patents are issued by the shop that first sells the product.
Copyright expires after one year unless renewed.
No — you must apply, demonstrate the invention is new and inventive, and pay fees; protection lasts up to 20 years. Copyright is the protection that arises automatically.

mcqs.q: Does a CE or UKCA mark mean a product was independently tested?
options: CE stands for 'Customer Excellence' awarded by retailers.
Patents are issued by the shop that first sells the product.
The CE mark proves an independent laboratory tested the product.
Not necessarily — CE/UKCA is usually the manufacturer's own declaration of conformity with safety requirements; the BSI Kitemark is the mark showing independent testing.
